sources.citation: Aramazani, Birusha A. 1985. Description de la langue havu (bantou J52): grammaire et lexique. These de doctorat, Universite Libre de Bruxelles (dir. Andre Coupez). 3 vols (336+408+363 scan pp.). Vol. 1: introduction, phonologie (ch.2), morphonologie (ch.3). Open access on ULB DI-fusion (record 2013/213653).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request); access check: not located online or in the libraries checked
sources.note: Nothing. The phonology chapter describes three level tonemes (H, L, downstepped H) plus two contour tones and contrastive vowel quantity (2.18-19, 2.45, pp.23-25, 49), then intonation (2.46-50, pp.50-55): tonality = pitch at syllable level, intonation = pitch at phrase level; assertive intoneme = drop of pitch and intensity phrase-finally with devoicing of the last syllable.
